responsibility: This AWK generator emits the C++ implementation that maps generated option indices to documentation URL suffixes for diagnostics and help. Reading the normalized .opt record stream via opt-read.awk and helper logic from opt-functions.awk, it walks the module’s option definitions, skips aliases and ignored entries that do not get stable enum cases, merges flags for duplicate switches across front ends, and generates get_opt_url_suffix with per-option switch cases that honor both language-specific LangUrlSuffix directives and language-independent UrlSuffix directives, producing the compiled lookup used by the option/diagnostic subsystem.
